entries.en: Didn't know she had a neural block on her, and one time she just snapped out of it. Like, during.
entries.ro: Nu știam că avea bloc neural pus, și o dată a ieșit din el pe loc. Așa, chiar în timpul actului.

entries.en: Huh. Must've been something up with the blocker. What model was it?
entries.ro: Hm. Sigur a fost ceva cu blockerul. Ce model era?
